question_text: A monitoring program retains every reading in RAM. Outline why sampling every hour rather than every minute reduces its working-memory requirement, assuming equal-size records over the same day.
adaptation_rationale: Retains sampling/storage reasoning through explicit RAM working-data context,not simulation data-collection theory.
solution: It stores24 readings rather than 1440, so storage for the reading records is reduced by a factor of 60, leaving more working memory available.
